name: GEO-Bangla
description: Complete evidence package for a pre-registered replication of generative engine optimization (GEO) in Bangla, released alongside the paper "Generative Engine Optimization in Bangla: A Pre-Registered Replication and Mechanism Study" (Islam and Akter, 2026). Contents: the frozen 300-query benchmark with English origin text; the complete sandbox pipeline source; all metric tables and analysis outputs, including the full 43,770-row impression table; the pre-registered analysis plan with its item-level audit; the closed cost ledger; rating sheets and blinding keys for the human validation gates; a stratified 20-query sample of raw engine answers; the mechanism-check script and outputs for the quotation-overlap decomposition; and an independent verification script that reimplements the visibility metric from scratch and reproduces the reported effects. Integrity: SHA-256 checksums cover every file (SHA256SUMS.txt), and the frozen analysis plan's own hash is published separately in PREREG_HASHES.txt so the plan can be shown unchanged since release. Run "python3 verify_results.py" inside 09_verification/ to reproduce the headline effects and spot-check metric extraction; scipy is the only dependency. Withheld permanently: the rewritten source texts. Three of the twelve conditions fabricate quotations, statistics and citations by design, and the affected material includes Bangla health and tax content.
